name: HEAL Program High School Internships (HealthPATH, Highland Hospital)
city: Oakland, CA (Wilma Chan Highland Hospital Campus)
what_you_do: You rotate through hospital units like the ER, the ICU and Labor and Delivery. You shadow doctors and nurses. You also learn skills like CPR and how to take vital signs in a practice lab.
grades: Fall and spring: 10th to 12th grade (one fall cohort is 12th grade only). Summer: 11th grade only.
who_can_apply: Enrolled in high school AND either live in Oakland or attend an OUSD school or charter, both when you apply and during the cohort. Spring cohorts are for 10th to 12th graders. Summer 2027 is for current 11th graders.
pay_detail: Fall 2026 cohorts: $400 stipend. Summer 2027: $2,000 stipend. Spring 2027 pay is not stated on the page.
duration: Spring 2027: about 5 weeks, Mon to Thu 4 to 6 pm (Cohort A Jan 11 to Feb 11, B Feb 22 to Mar 25, C Apr 5 to May 13). Summer 2027: June 14 to July 23, weekdays 9 am to 4:30 pm.
deadline_text: Spring 2027 cohorts: application opens Oct 26, 2026 and closes Nov 17, 2026; interviews week of Nov 30; decisions Dec 15, 2026. Summer 2027: opens Jan 5, 2027, closes Jan 27, 2027. Fall 2026 cohorts closed Aug 27, 2026.
how_to_apply: Online application that must be done in one sitting (no save). Pick your cohort, upload a resume, and answer short-answer questions (75 words minimum each for spring, 150 for summer). Draft answers first. Then an interview. Questions: healprogram@alamedahealthsystem.org.
notes: As of 2026-10-16, the 2026-27 dates, pay and rules are on the HealthPATH page, healthpath-ahs.org/healprogramapply. That page does not load with https. So this card links to the AHS news post that points to it. Type healthpath-ahs.org/healprogramapply into your browser for the live dates and the form. The page says HEAL is for high school students of color. The written rule is that you live in Oakland or go to an OUSD school. The AHS volunteer program is a different program, and it is for ages 18 and up. The page does not say if you need a work permit for the stipend. Ask the program.
